firm_data.firm_description: Schwab & Gasparini PLLC is a commercial litigation firm that provides clients with big firm services with small firm responsiveness and accessibility. They utilize legal analytics and a team approach to provide efficient legal representation.
notable_facts: Founded in 2007 by lawyers from larger litigation law firms in New York.
The firm has four offices: Syracuse, White Plains, Hudson Valley, and Albany.
technology_signals: Utilizes the latest in legal technology.
Access to real-time juror information during selection, medical record searching and processing, social media investigation and data management.

email.subject: AI for Schwab & Gasparini, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Andrew,

Your approach to commercial litigation stands out: big firm services with the responsiveness that only smaller, focused teams can deliver. That combination of legal analytics and team-based efficiency is exactly what separates firms that scale from those that plateau.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of your practice: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your White Plains office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
